title: Balanced BST height
statementMd:
`values` is a sorted list. Imagine building a height-balanced BST by always choosing the middle element (the left middle for even sizes) of the current range as the root. Return the height of that tree (number of nodes on the longest root-to-leaf path, 0 when empty).

**Example:** `bst_from_sorted_height([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7])` returns `3`.
hints: Only the sizes of the halves matter.
